items.title: What Sets Cadence Design Systems (CDNS) Apart After Its PCIe 6.0 Milestone?
items.summary: Cadence Design Systems (NasdaqGS: CDNS) reported that its PCIe 6.0 subsystem achieved first pass compliance at an official PCI-SIG workshop and is now listed on the PCI-SIG Integrators List. The production ready subsystem targets high bandwidth connectivity needs in AI and high performance computing markets. items.title: Synopsys' Core Engine Grew Far Slower Than Its Revenue
items.summary: Synopsys (SNPS) booked revenue of $2.477 billion in fiscal Q3 2026, up about 42% year over year, and the shares have still lost about 30% over the past twelve months. Look past that headline at the line underneath it: EDA grew 8.5%. That single-digit number is the pace of the design tools business Synopsys had before the Ansys deal.
